notes.title: Terletski Games presents: The New Game!
notes.content:
[h2][b]A new game by Vitalii Terletskii, co-creator of [i]Alt Girl for Skoof[/i]![/b][/h2][p][/p][p]For the first time in its history, the totalitarian nation of Sobakistan is opening its borders.
The occasion? A grand rehearsal for the funeral of the Supreme Leader, [b]Comrade Buddy[/b]. Everything must be flawless: the canine army is scrubbing the streets, journalists have been carefully selected, and the population has been warned.[/p][p][/p][p][b][i]You are one of the few allowed in.[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Sobakistan: The Land of Dogs[/b] is a darkly satirical narrative game set in a sealed-off state ruled entirely by intelligent dogs. The story unfolds through dialogue, hidden details, and a gradual shift between six playable characters — each with their own view of the same terrifying world.[/p][p]No freedom of choice.
No objective truth.
Just a documentary assignment, a pixelated surveillance device, and the creeping feeling that someone is already watching you.[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3742720/Sobakistan_The_Land_of_Dogs/" style="button" buttoncolor="#f11e1e"]Wishlist it now![/url]
[b]Glory to Sobakistan.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950025/85ef4d3c520a3c2c5a9dc5a0e2c7e67a40fa8d1d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]🎮 [b]Key Features:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]A rich, hand-crafted world and deep story based on the acclaimed comic of the same name[/p][/*][*][p]Six playable characters, each with a unique perspective[/p][/*][*][p]Choices with consequences, leading to multiple endings[/p][/*][*][p]Full immersion in a totalitarian atmosphere[/p][/*][*][p]Puzzle-solving, stealth elements, and item collection[/p][/*][*][p]Retro aesthetics with in-universe narrative justification[/p][/*][*][p]Meta- and 4D-narrative mechanics (some may surprise you)[/p][/*][*][p]Created by the original comic’s authors: [b]Vitalii Terletskii[/b] and [b]Katya[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Original soundtrack by [b]Pasha Zhdanov[/b] ([i]Ada[/i]) and [b]Pazetic Ocean[/b][/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: A rich, hand-crafted world and deep story based on the acclaimed comic of the same name
Six playable characters, each with a unique perspective
Choices with consequences, leading to multiple endings
Full immersion in a totalitarian atmosphere
Puzzle-solving, stealth elements, and item collection
Retro aesthetics with in-universe narrative justification
Meta- and 4D-narrative mechanics (some may surprise you)
Created by the original comic’s authors: Vitalii Terletskii and Katya
Original soundtrack by Pasha Zhdanov (Ada) and Pazetic Ocean

notes.title: Free holiday update!
notes.content:
In honor of the upcoming holidays, we have added an X-Mas update to the game!

It will be free for all owners of the DLC / complete collection of the game.

- X-mas costumes for all 
- X-mas main musical theme
- X-mas snow

All this can be turned on / off in the settings menu.

Thank you very much for this year, you made it unforgettable.
Thank you for playing our game.

Happy upcoming holidays!

notes.title: DLC ANNOUNCEMENT: An Alt girl for Skoof - More, more!
notes.content:
A big DLC addition is planned for release in the second half of July. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3058410/]Add to your wishlist on Steam[/url] so you don’t miss the release!

What awaits you:

- Three new Altushkas - Nyusha, Lisa and Kira, each with a unique story
- Altushki is voiced by Alina Rin, Persona 99 and Albina Seksova
- Already includes full voice acting of all characters from Prophet Sunboy
- Completion time is no less than that of the main part of the game
- 9 (nine) new endings (if we haven’t mixed anything up)
- Mini-games with trickы
- Significant development of the plot and universe of the game

Add-on price: $2.49, for the game you will need the main part, which, by the way, is now on sale [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2901520/_/)]on Steam with a discount[/url] 50%.

The game is in post-production stage, the wait won't be long!
Subscribe [url=https://t.me/altushka_official]to our social networks[/url] to be the first to know about all the news
